apply_align_long_axis: create a transform that rotates an image 90 degrees to align its long axis with the target input size
apply_bitmap_threshold: build a transform that applies a lookup table threshold to convert pixel values below a cutoff to zero
apply_erosion_filter: create a transform that applies morphological erosion using min pooling on tensors or min filter on PIL images
apply_dilation_filter: build a transform that applies morphological dilation using max pooling on tensors or max filter on PIL images
crop_margin_around_content: create a transform that crops a PIL image to the bounding rectangle of non-background content using a gray threshold
